properties.statement: Wrote a throwaway Python script against the committed export to answer "which capabilities claim they are built but have no passing check?" — walking capability status against VERIFIES edges to a passing check, because the loop reported the COUNT and named nothing. The count said 1; my derivation said 10. I could not reconcile the two, so I could not tell whether the tool and I were answering different questions or whether one of us was wrong, and I shipped the release leaving the item open on that basis. The report that holds the underlying detail was reachable but returned ~65,000 characters and overflowed the reply, so it could not be read in the session that needed it. THE COST IS THE UNRECONCILED NUMBER, not the script: a count with no reachable members cannot be checked, and an agent that cannot check it either trusts it or rebuilds it by hand — I did both and got two answers.
